## Requirements: Project default ENV editing and explicit Session create inheritance

### Problem / current baseline (2026-11-15)
Project already declares `session_defaults.env_profile_ids: Vec<String>` (Server ENV filenames; ordered, up to 32) in `crates/nession-protocol/src/contracts/project/v1.rs`. `server.session.create` already resolves a Project's defaults when request `env_files` is empty, snapshots the profiles into **Session-owned** Environment Binding (#170), and never rebinds an existing Session when Project changes (#3025 SC-03, accepted). Session → Project membership is independent (#3082).

**New gap:** Project Create/Settings uses `ProjectDraft` without `session_defaults`; `useProjectDraftForm` omits defaults on create and preserves them unchanged on update, and `ProjectFormFields` offers no ENV configuration. `ProjectDetail` can only display existing defaults. `useCreateSessionForm` resets `selectedEnv=[]`, and `CreateSessionDialog` only displays an empty `EnvFileMultiSelect` even though the Server silently inherits Project profiles. Empty `env_files` currently means *inherit*, so a user cannot deliberately choose **No ENV**. This is a **new design/interaction and opt-out behavior**, not a reason to reopen historical accepted #3021/#3025/#170.

### Product decision and ownership
- Global Server ENV Library owns ENV files; Project holds **ordered references** as Session defaults, **never copies or owns secrets**. No new persistent ProjectEnvironment, file store, or binding implementation.
- `Project.session_defaults.env_profile_ids` remains the canonical field for this focused iteration (Server-scoped ENV filenames; do **not** silently pretend Agent-scoped files are supported as Project defaults). Reuse Project CRUD, canonical validation, and the existing ENV list/select component; protect `shell` and `sandbox_policy_ref` on full Project updates.
- On **Project Settings**, users can add/remove/reorder default Server ENV references, see missing/unavailable references without leaking values, and persist an explicit empty default list. Project Detail shows them in order. Project Create may offer the same optional defaults without making them required.
- On **Project → Create Session**, show the *effective* chosen profiles and their origin. Offer **Use Project defaults** (default), **Custom ENV selection**, and **No environment**. Inherit may show an empty state when Project has no defaults; explicit custom selection is an ordered replacement (not additive); No environment means an explicit empty replacement even if Project has defaults. For ordinary non-Project create, keep the existing optional ENV selection and avoid inventing a Project dependency.
- **Protocol ambiguity fix:** extend the create request with an optional explicit selection-mode field (e.g. `env_selection_mode: inherit | replace`, final name must follow snake_case). New clients send `inherit` to resolve Project defaults; `replace` uses `env_files` exactly, including `[]`. **Absent field keeps current legacy behavior** (empty `env_files` with a Project inherits; nonempty overrides). Reject unsupported values/mismatched selections deterministically; no silent fallback. Keep Server as final authority for snapshots and Session Binding.
- Project changes only affect **future** creations. Existing Sessions remain independent; Project deletion does not delete Session bindings or ENV files. ENV file contents are never shown in Project selection, logs or UI prototype. Missing reference at create time must fail visibly rather than silently start with an empty/different environment. Preserve desired vs observed reconciliation semantics; no automatic reapply when files/Project defaults change.
- Web/App reuse the existing Project settings and Session operation surfaces (#3089 / #3137), with App owning a single header/back at each depth; do not create a second Project nav tree or copy a Session ENV workspace.

### Prototype (Required)
**Decision:** Required for the new Project Settings editing + create-time three-way choice and Web/App state semantics. Publish an interactive mock on the shared `prototype` branch in `project-env-3649/`, with immutable source pin and Pages deep link only after verified HTTPS publication. Compare against the current `project-session-3025` and `session-operation-surfaces-3089` prototypes; new artifact owns only this **distinct** inheritance decision, not their existing broader flows.

**Scenarios:** Project Settings → ordered defaults → save → Project Detail → Create Session → inherit/custom/none preview → explicit create → Session binding summary; reopen Settings and change defaults → existing Session unchanged / new Session updated; missing ENV, no Project defaults, validation, retry, Web 1180/1024 and App 390/375, single App Back and scroll ownership.

**Fidelity:** business data/creation/revision are in-browser simulated state. A published prototype, even browser verified, is *not* production acceptance.

#### Interactive prototype (source committed; Pages not yet verified)

- **Preview URL (publication unverified):** https://bestnathan.github.io/nession/prototypes/project-env-3649/index.html
- **Immutable source:** https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/tree/59e7fdc86aa631b1df2a26bb21d3ebf5db892320/project-env-3649
- **Scenario / fidelity:** https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/59e7fdc86aa631b1df2a26bb21d3ebf5db892320/project-env-3649/README.md
- **Included:** Project Settings ordered defaults, Session create inherit/custom/none, Session-owned binding snapshots, missing ENV/empty defaults, Web/App true-size controls, App single back/header mock; sources are HTML/CSS/JS and sibling shared frame.
- **Checks:** connector readback confirms target four files and both root gallery links at remote `prototype` head `59e7fdc86aa631b1df2a26bb21d3ebf5db892320`. The uploaded JavaScript parses successfully via `new Function(source)`. Actual Chromium interaction, fixture pixels, Pages manifest source SHA and live HTTPS preview remain **UNVERIFIED** (the public URL could not be accessed from the available web verifier). Do not equate source upload with live preview, production API or E2E.


### Implementation surfaces and proof classification
- Project form: `web/src/product/project/{types.ts,model/projectDraft.ts,hooks/useProjectDraftForm.ts,components/ProjectFormFields.tsx,components/ProjectDetail.tsx}`.
- Session form: `web/src/product/session/{hooks/useCreateSessionForm.ts,components/CreateSessionDialog.tsx}`; Server/protocol: `crates/nession-protocol/src/contracts/session/v1.rs`, `crates/nession-server/src/server/handler/server_session_create_v1.rs`.
- SC-01/SC-02 → **SCN-02** Web/App Chromium browser Case, exact production PR SHA; full flow, geometry, keyboard and project context.
- SC-03/SC-04 → **SCN-03** isolated Server+Agent+tmux protocol/runtime Case; positive + negative create and durable binding diff, unchanged legacy payload.
- SC-05 → **SCN-08** prototype/source artifact + exact pinned SHA / authenticated Pages verification. Mock verification does not count toward production SC-01..04.

### Success Criteria
- [ ] SC-01 Project Create/Settings can configure/reorder/remove persisted default ENV references without losing unrelated Session defaults; Project Detail displays the exact ordered list and missing-state feedback with no secret values.
- [ ] SC-02 Web/App Project→Create Session initially previews inherited ordered ENV, supports explicit custom and **No environment**, and shows the correct effective selection after switching modes, errors, close/reopen, and Agent/Project change. App has exactly one current-depth Back/Header and usable scrolling at 390/375; Web works at 1180/1024.
- [ ] SC-03 New create requests distinguish inherit vs explicit replacement including empty list; Server materializes/saves exactly the effective Session-owned binding in declared order and fails invalid/unavailable references without environment fallback. Omitted new mode preserves legacy create behavior.
- [ ] SC-04 Editing/deleting a Project or editing its default ENV file does not retroactively change an existing Session's desired/materialized binding; newly created Sessions see updated Project defaults, and explicit Session reapply remains separately owned.
- [x] SC-05 A standalone interactive Web/App prototype and fidelity README cover Project Settings → inherited/custom/none create → independent existing Session, missing-file and responsive states; the owning Issue pins an immutable source revision and distinguishes unverified vs independently verified Pages/Chromium proof.
